summary: Section B fully satisfies the load-bearing brief: total B12 unreliability, grey-zone quantification (45% vs 14%), holoTC/MMA/tHcy functional markers with correct specificity ordering, renal caveat on MMA, and the stepwise diagnostic algorithm are all present and precisely sourced. Both anchor Clin Chem papers (Valente 2011 PMID 21482749 AUC 0.90; Clarke 2007 PMID 17363419 AUC 0.85) verified against their published records — first authors, co-author lists, and AUC figures confirmed exact; no Hindawi/Disease Markers host present anywhere in the section.
